_doc: Proof by Willow instances and their organisations (app/proof_orgs.py). An instance is one retailer's Proof deployment; its orgs are the retailer and the brands it stocks. Brand names must match api/seed/products.json exactly. "brands": "*" = every brand in the catalog. "brand_orgs_from_catalog": one brand org per catalog brand, id "<instance>-<slug>" (today's 'view as any brand'). Memberships are stored, never seeded.
